title: Prepare a fail-closed paired-run manifest for the existing project declaration case
body:
## Goal
Prepare the smallest concrete baseline-method increment for the existing public AF project declaration case, without executing model comparisons. First report the existing run-record evidence and missing fields; then prepare a data-only paired-run manifest and admission rehearsal. Expected gain: benchmark/project-paired-0136.md and .json identify exactly what would admit or reject one matched declaration-only development pair under protocol.md baseline. Reuse existing D1-D4 originals/keys and preserve closed reviews. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Check .session/exports/manifest.json for #537/#541/#633 and record input availability, starting commit/tree, relevant input hashes and actual exposure. Before designing, inspect protocol.md baseline and the existing project case metadata; perform one bounded filename/content search under benchmark for existing paired-run manifests or substantive paired results. Report what exists and reuse applicable records rather than creating a competing contract. Missing evidence is not global absence.
- [ ] Write benchmark/project-paired-0136.md and .json. Restrict the example to the preserved original project's D1-D4 textual declarations with independently checked XML citations. Resolve exact original/key paths and pin their hashes from bytes and exported review scope. Keep proposed manifest separate from frozen case/key data. Native resolution, VI diagrams, dependency closure, writing outcomes and save-version behavior are outside the measured declaration scope and remain gaps. Do not edit the original, old keys, protocol, preparation index, existing checkers or research files.
- [ ] Specify paired arm parity: identical question/artifact/documentation hashes and common prompt; only reader access and minimal arm instruction differ. Pin reader representation/configuration and allowed calls or leave them explicitly unavailable. Record exact provider/model snapshot or bounded-window limitation, generation/modalities/settings, fresh-session/key-access controls, total context/output/token/time budgets including tool output, tool-call budget/accounting, arm order, repetitions, stopping rule and development precision/cost rationale. Unknown resources/settings remain null with reasons and admission blocked; do not fabricate quota or select a numerical quality threshold.
- [ ] Bind the existing reference inventory, scoring/mapping rules and fixed correctness/grounding denominators by exact file/hash/locator, without reproducing a new key. Declare reader fidelity as a separate required probe suite, unavailable until its prerequisites exist; no-tool fidelity is not applicable. Record planned/attempted/executed/scored/complete-pair accounting, omitted/extra/contradictory claims, raw transcript/request/image/tool/usage/error evidence identities, retry/cache/truncation/exhaustion handling and cost/time limitations. No absent run or synthetic record receives a semantic pass.
- [ ] Include a deterministic data-only admission rehearsal with explicit expected versus observed decisions for an incomplete draft, a fully specified synthetic pair, mismatched common input, unequal budget, missing repetition/stopping plan, missing actual model identity, incomplete pair and missing/unverified key or isolation evidence. Synthetic placeholders must be visibly synthetic and never satisfy real admission. Exercise record consistency using only local Python/data, not a model transport, reader, evaluator, historical builder or benchmark run. Save bounded rehearsal evidence in the two new files; identify what still needs substantive independent review or trusted execution.
- [ ] Report the concrete preparation gain and remaining admission blockers in .session/report.md; do not claim benchmark readiness, a measured gain, withheld/model-unseen status, completed comparison, native evidence or method acceptance. No new owner request, publication category, spending, product code, native experiment or evaluator change.
## Verification
python3 -c "import json,pathlib,hashlib; p=pathlib.Path; d=json.loads(p('benchmark/project-paired-0136.json').read_text()); assert isinstance(d,dict) and d; assert p('benchmark/project-paired-0136.md').stat().st_size>0; assert hashlib.sha256(p('benchmark/real-project-0107/original.lvproj').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='1d5e140df788ce1f91c89241bbdb1227c5e4cc6fdf6efbbd820974bbe6082dcf'; print('paired preparation files and original identity: OK')"
This structural repository check does not certify admission logic, semantic scores, isolation, model execution or readiness; inspect the substantive rehearsal and its limitations in the report.
## Context
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md baseline requires matched model/prompt/budgets, repetitions and separate fidelity; benchmark/protocol.md baseline describes those requirements but explicitly supplies no concrete paired run. This task targets that remaining gap rather than reopening closed keys.
- #633 independently CLEARs only #629 dependency-byte measurement at 8d824c68eb6c2f9674cbc69ba5f1b451d6452224, not native resolution or method readiness. Its U03 proposal needs new permitted provenance/version/mapping evidence; do not repeat inventory or U01 hashing.
- #537/#541 establish the original project declaration scope. Treat public case/key familiarity honestly; a draft manifest is not executed isolation.
## Budget
Read .session/exports/manifest.json and exported #537/#541/#633 reports; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md, accepted-limits.md and roles.md; benchmark/protocol.md baseline plus only relevant tasks/oracle/split rules; benchmark/real-project-0107.md, .json and original.lvproj; source-pin fields in benchmark/sources.md. Search benchmark filenames and paired-run/manifest references once with short output; read at most three directly relevant existing baseline/run-contract records if found. Follow at most two exact case/key/scoring references necessary to bind D1-D4; if insufficient, record unresolved identity instead of opening the wider WP1/C1 history. No whole large JSON, journal/history sweep, prepared-cache lookup, binary dump, old checker replay, source/product/native/benchmark execution or model call. Write only the two new benchmark files plus session outputs. Save findings early; if partial, name completed pins/rehearsal and the one remaining step so a continuation does not redo them.
